description: This page presents the full case study for a single project using the Problem → Solution → Result narrative structure. It includes project scope, tools and methodologies applied, measurable outcomes, client information, and visuals such as diagrams or GIS maps. This deep-dive view builds credibility with prospective clients evaluating the firm for similar infrastructure challenges.
navigation_note: Opens when a visitor clicks a project card or 'View Case Study' button on the Projects list page. Back button or breadcrumb returns to the Projects portfolio overview.

endpoints.purpose: Fetch full case study details for a single project by id including problem, solution, and results

request_payload_ui_passing.id: Injected from the current route params — not a user input. The page already knows this value from the URL (e.g. /projects/:id) and sends it automatically as a query param on page load
